# 1 Chronicles Chapter 17 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 379v–380r

---

**17:1** And-it-was as David sat [yashav] in-his-house, and-said David to-Natan the-prophet: Behold, I am-dwelling [yoshev] in-a-house of-cedars ['arazim], and-the-ark of-the-covenant of-YHWH [is] under curtains [yeri'ot].

**17:2** And-said Natan to David: All that [is] in-your-heart, do, for the-Elohim [is] with-you.

**17:3** And-it-was in-that night, and-the-word of-Elohim came to Natan, saying:

**17:4** Go and-say to David my-servant: Thus says YHWH: Not you shall-build for-me the-house to-dwell-in [lashevet].

**17:5** For not have-I-dwelt in-a-house from the-day that I-brought-up Yisra'el until this day, and-I-was from-tent to-tent and-from-tabernacle [mi-mishkan].

**17:6** In-all that I-walked-about [hithalakhti] with-all Yisra'el, [did] a-word did-I-speak with-one of-the-judges [shoftey] of-Yisra'el whom I-commanded to-shepherd my-people, saying: Why have-you not built for-me a-house of-cedars?

**17:7** And-now, thus shall-you-say to-my-servant, to-David: Thus says YHWH of-hosts [tseva'ot]: I took-you from the-pasture [min-ha-naveh], from after the-flock, to-be ruler [nagid] over my-people Yisra'el.

**17:8** And-I-was with-you in-all where you-went [halakhta], and-I-cut-off all your-enemies from-before-you, and-I-made for-you a-name like-the-name of-the-great-ones who [are] on the-earth.

**17:9** And-I-appointed [vesamti] a-place for-my-people Yisra'el, and-I-planted-them [untativ], and-they-shall-dwell in-their-place and-shall-be-troubled [yirgaz] no more, and-the-sons of-wickedness [beney avlah] shall-not-waste-them again as-at-the-first,

**17:10** and-from the-days that I-commanded judges over my-people Yisra'el. And-I-subdued [vehiknati] all your-enemies. And-I-declare to-you that a-house shall-YHWH-build for-you.

**17:11** And-it-shall-be when your-days are-fulfilled to-go with your-fathers, and-I-will-raise-up your-seed [zar'akha] after-you who shall-be from your-sons, and-I-will-establish his-kingdom.

**17:12** He shall-build for-me a-house, and-I-will-establish his-throne until eternity [ad olam].

**17:13** I will-be to-him as-a-father, and-he shall-be to-me as-a-son; and-my-loyal-love [chasdi] I-will-not-remove from-him as I-removed [it] from the-one-who was before-you.

**17:14** And-I-will-stand-him [veha'amadtihu] in-my-house and-in-my-kingdom until eternity, and-his-throne shall-be established until eternity.

**17:15** According-to-all these words and-according-to-all this vision, so spoke Natan to David.

**17:16** And-came the-king David and-sat before YHWH, and-said: Who [am] I, YHWH Elohim, and-what [is] my-house, that you-have-brought-me until here?

**17:17** And-this was small in-your-eyes, Elohim, and-you-spoke concerning the-house of-your-servant for-a-distant-time [le-merachok], and-you-have-regarded-me [ure'itani] according-to-the-rank [ketor] of-the-man of-the-height [ha-ma'alah], YHWH Elohim.

**17:18** What more can David [add] to-you for-the-honor [likhvod] of your-servant? And-you, you-know your-servant.

**17:19** YHWH, for-the-sake-of your-servant and-according-to your-heart you-have-done all this greatness, to-make-known all [these] great-things [gedullot].

**17:20** YHWH, there-is-none like-you, and-there-is-no Elohim besides-you, according-to-all that we-have-heard with-our-ears.

**17:21** And-who [is] like-your-people Yisra'el, one nation [goy echad] on the-earth whom Elohim went to-redeem [lifdot] for-himself [as] a-people, to-make for-you a-name of-great-things and-fearful-things [gedullot venora'ot], to-drive-out [legaresh] nations from-before your-people whom you-redeemed from-Mitsrayim?

**17:22** And-you-made your-people Yisra'el for-yourself as-a-people until eternity, and-you YHWH became for-them as-Elohim.

**17:23** And-now, YHWH, the-word that you-spoke concerning your-servant and-concerning his-house, let-it-be-established [ye'amen] until eternity, and-do as you-spoke.

**17:24** And-let-it-be-established, and-let-your-name be-great until eternity, saying: YHWH of-hosts, Elohey Yisra'el [is] Elohim for-Yisra'el. And-the-house of-David your-servant [shall be] established before-you.

**17:25** For you, my-Elohim, have-uncovered [galita] the-ear of-your-servant to-build for-him a-house. Therefore your-servant has-found [matsa] [courage] to-pray before-you.

**17:26** And-now, YHWH, you [are] the-Elohim, and-you-spoke to your-servant this goodness [ha-tovah].

**17:27** And-now, you-have-been-pleased [ho'alta] to-bless the-house of-your-servant to-be before-you forever [le'olam], for you, YHWH, have-blessed, and-[it is] blessed forever.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.6 — "judges" not "tribes":** The Chronicler has "judges" (shoftey) where 2 Samuel 7:7 has "tribes" (shivtey). This is likely a deliberate change — the Chronicler envisions shepherding as a judicial function. Some scholars read this as a scribal variant (shin-bet-tet vs. shin-pe-tet).

**v.13 — No "rod of men":** The parallel in 2 Samuel 7:14 reads "when he commits iniquity, I will discipline him with the rod of men." The Chronicler omits this entirely. The covenant with David's line is presented without the conditional threat of punishment — a theological revision of the first order.

**v.14 — "in my house and in my kingdom":** Where 2 Samuel 7:16 reads "your house and your kingdom," the Chronicler changes to "my house and my kingdom." The Davidic dynasty rules God's kingdom, not their own. This is central to the Chronicler's theology of theocratic kingship.

**v.17 — ketor ha-ma'alah:** This phrase is obscure. The word *tor* or *ketor* is debated. It may mean "row, rank" or be connected to the Aramaic for "law/custom." EMET preserves the difficulty: "the rank of the man of the height."

*— EMET*
